dashboard.label: Security Monitoring Dashboard
dashboard.description: Overview: failed logins, suspicious network, file integrity, anomalies.

search.query: index=auth_logs action=failed OR status="failure" | stats count by user | sort - count | head 10
index=auth_logs action=failed | stats count by src_ip, user | where count >= 5 | sort - count
index=network_logs action=allowed | stats sum(bytes) as total_bytes by src_ip | sort - total_bytes | head 10
index=network_logs | lookup known_good_external_hosts ip AS dest_ip OUTPUT ip as match | where isnull(match) | stats count by dest_ip | sort - count | head 20
index=sysmon (event_id=11 OR event_type="file_create" OR action="file_modified") | stats latest(_time) as last_seen values(file_path) as files by host | sort - last_seen
